fusions.name: Shake Dry
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your lash, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ankle Upend
fusions.desc: Loops the lash round the ankles of an enemy within 3.5 tiles and upends it, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and lowers its armour by 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bob Under the Backswing
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds and bobs you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Beads on Oiled Leather
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
